title: Choose the visual world for Santi Subidia's Portfolio
question: The roll assigned Interactive Creative Studio. Choose this direction, explore an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Interactive Creative Studio
options.lineage: Modern creative engineering & generative canvas showcases
options.thesis: The portfolio as an interactive physics/generative canvas playground that proves frontend craft instantly.
options.viewport: Full-bleed dark canvas with responsive fluid/particle physics reacting to cursor, bold display typography, floating project specimen cards with live demo triggers.
options.risk: Can feel overly decorative if the engineering case studies and technical depth aren't front and center.

raised.raise: Tactile layer shift and subtle micro-texture on project specimen cards on hover.
Integrated compact live telemetry / command palette bar for instant navigation and tech stack inspection.

options.label: Interactive Component Workbench
options.lineage: Precision design systems & engineering testbeds (Storybook / Linear design lab)
options.thesis: Every project and capability showcased as a living, inspectable component specimen with real-time controls.
options.viewport: A dense, calibrated split layout: left rail with developer index & telemetry, main canvas featuring live interactive component specimens you can tweak in real-time.
options.risk: Very dense technical feel; prioritizes engineering inspection over fluid storytelling.

options.label: Risograph Web System
options.lineage: Independent risograph print publications and posters
options.thesis: Tactile two-color spot ink layers that misregister and grain over warm toothy paper.
options.viewport: Warm paper canvas with misregistering spot-ink cards and high-contrast typography.
options.case: Striking visual personality and tactile warmth; loses slightly on software engineering-native vibe.
options.risk: Feels more editorial/illustrative than software engineering-native.

options.label: Phosphor Terminal Midnight
options.lineage: P1 green phosphor CRT terminals & machine rooms
options.case: Unmistakable systems atmosphere, but too monochromatic for showcasing modern rich UI/UX projects.
options.kept: Live terminal command bar / telemetry inspection.

options.label: Noir One-Sheet Duotone
options.lineage: 1950s cinematic one-sheet posters and duotone lithography
options.case: Strong cinematic drama, but lacks interactive software texture.
options.kept: Dramatic directional lighting and shadow depth on cards.

options.label: PC-98 Sixteen-Color Field
options.case: Highly nostalgic retro aesthetic, but conflicts with modern responsive React/Next.js product expectations.

canonCard.label: Modern Minimalist Dark Portfolio (Category Standard)
canonCard.thesis: Clean, spacious dark mode developer portfolio with subtle gradients, card borders, and standard project cards.
canonCard.viewport: Centered header intro, featured projects grid, skills badge list, simple contact footer.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from the typical developer template.
